7802.title: Panel setup repeats during thread changes
7802.rootCauseOneLine: Transient plugin visibility readiness replaces a live flat panel with a split container, repeating content setup.

prReviews.verdict: Static approach matches the reproduced cause; branch and tests not executed.

7802.proposedFix: Avoid mounting live split-enabled panel content until fixed tabs are ready, while preserving readiness-gated layout restoration. Existing open PR #7803 owns the fix.
7802.caveats: Real component/hook/core Info lifecycle reproduction in two clean trusted checkouts; no full browser, default Git plugin, open-file, terminal socket, or timing verification. No production changes.
